payload.posture: Read Acts 3:1–10 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter and John encounter a man at the temple gate; Peter addresses him, takes his hand, and the healed man enters walking and praising God. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
